newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic's Micro Jewel II implanted.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic's Micro Jewel II implanted.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said the first human implants of its new Micro Jewel II implantable defibrillator were accomplished.

The Micro Jewel II -- at a volume of 54 cubic centimeters and a weight of 97 gram -- is the world's smallest and lightest implantable defibrillator, a device that treats too-rapid heartbeat, Medtronic said.
Micro Jewel II's were Wednesday at a Swiss hospital and on Thursday at a Norwegian hospital.
The Micro Jewel II follows the Micro Jewel Model 7221, which was introduced in July, Medtronic said.

Separately, the company said all three models of its advanced Sprint transvenous leads, which carry electrical impulses between implanted defibrillators and the heart, have entered the clinical evaluation phase.
